sentences.text: Ronda Jean Rousey -LRB- -LSB- ˈraʊzi -RSB- born February 1 , 1987 -RRB- is an American mixed martial artist , judoka , and actress .	mixed martial artist	mixed martial arts	judoka	judoka	actress	actress

Rousey was the first American woman to earn an Olympic medal in judo -LRB- bronze -RRB- , which she won at the 2008 Summer Olympics in Beijing .	judo	judo	Olympic medal in judo	List of Olympic medalists in judo	2008 Summer Olympics	2008 Summer Olympics
She is the former UFC Women 's Bantamweight Champion , as well as the last Strikeforce Women 's Bantamweight Champion .	Bantamweight	Bantamweight (MMA)

She won 12 consecutive MMA fights , six in the Ultimate Fighting Championship -LRB- UFC -RRB- , before suffering her first loss to Holly Holm in November 2015 ; she won 11 of those fights in the first round , nine of them by armbar submission .	Ultimate Fighting Championship	Ultimate Fighting Championship	Holly Holm	Holly Holm
Rousey trains under Gokor Chivichyan of the Hayastan MMA Academy , and Edmond Tarverdyan of the Glendale Fighting Club .	Gokor Chivichyan	Gokor Chivichyan
In May 2015 , two magazines ranked Rousey as the most `` dominant '' active athlete .
In September 2015 , voters in an online ESPN poll selected Rousey as the Best Female Athlete Ever .
Later that month , she claimed to be the UFC 's highest paid fighter , male or female .
In 2015 , she was the third most searched person on Google .	Google	Google Search
As of January 2017 , Rousey is ranked the # 4 female bantamweight fighter in the world according to the UFC , and # 9 by Sherdog .	Sherdog	Sherdog
Rousey 's first feature film role was the 2014 film The Expendables 3 .	The Expendables 3	The Expendables 3
In 2015 , she had roles in the films Furious 7 and Entourage .	Furious 7	Furious 7	Entourage	Entourage (film)
